name: smwmusic-mario-is-missing-snes-city-secured
title: Mario is Missing! (SNES) - City Secured!
description:
The theme played when you successfully secure (or finish) a city in Mario is Missing! for the SNES.

Can be used in a cutscene or as a goal theme.

Though you might want to set the wXX command to 255 if you're using it as a goal theme, so it can be heard clearly.
